name: Serpent's Gaze
disable: DC 29 Thievery check (expert) to carefully cover the eye without triggering the hazard, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 29) to counteract the magic
reset: The trap resets when the door is opened and closed.

items.name: Entrancing Eye
items.text:
Trigger A non-sekmin creature without Nuzial's sigil moves adjacent to the door

---
Effect The trap attempts to place a lingering hypnotic vision of the serpent's eye in the minds of all creatures within a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area must attempt a DC 30 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 day. This effect can be counteracted with a 4th-rank Clear Mind spell.

Failure As success, and the creature is Dazzled on the first round of any encounter.

Critical Failure As failure, except the duration is 1 week.

text: The circle opens to reveal a slitted serpent's eye, which begins to spin in hypnotizing fashion.
